explication: MCP Adapter exposes WordPress Abilities API functionality to MCP clients as tools, resources, and prompts. Clients connect through HTTP or WP-CLI STDIO; requests are handled by a server and dispatched to the relevant MCP operation, which checks permissions and executes the registered ability or component before returning protocol results. The README also documents multiple servers, custom transports, per-server authentication, and pluggable error handling and observability. The tree and excerpts support these subsystem boundaries; some internal wiring is not shown, so uncertain call edges are omitted.
